nodes.name: 结合物理降尺度与单变量线性回归的方法
nodes.description: 两步法：物理步骤基于Monin–Obukhov表面层理论将HIRLAM约140 m混合层风按局地粗糙度长度调整至10 m（Estimator A忽略稳定度，Estimator B加入HIRLAM稳定度修正）；统计步骤利用五个站点汇总的局地估计与观测建立单变量线性回归，再应用于第六个独立站点修正剩余大尺度模式误差。

nodes.name: real-world wind speed datasets from Xinjiang, China::evidence
nodes.description: The experimental dataset used to evaluate the proposed model consists of four groups of real wind speed series collected from Xinjiang, China... The data were gathered using high-sensitivity stationary wind measurement base stations equipped with dual-channel redundancy sensors for real-time collection... Key technical specifications include a sampling interval ranging from 3 seconds to 10 minutes, a measurement range of 0–70 m/s, a maximum resolution of 0.1 m/s, and station locations primarily in basin areas... The real-world wind speed datasets from Xinjiang, China include data collection equipment, sampling details, environmental conditions, dataset length, and the 0.4:0.4:0.2 training/validation/testing split.
